text_block_list.text:
Cultural exchange festival with overseas horse girls
hastily arranged.
Decorating academy grounds—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hallway decorations progressing smoothly.
...This section showcases academy history.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Many memorabilia borrowed from chairwoman's office.
Proceed with utmost caution, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Kyaah!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Are you alright? Injured?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, completely unhurt...! But,
Chairwoman's precious wooden sculpture cracked!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That sculpture shaped like horse girl... I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am supervisor.
Continue working. I will inform Chairwoman myself.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, piste area seems secured.
We can demonstrate serious duel with this.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid!
As long as crowd enjoys it, magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Here you were, Chairwoman Akikawa.
President too...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Discussing festival performance!
Meeting for fencing show underway!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Pardon interruption during discussion.
Matter to report.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That wooden sculpture suffered damage.
Oversight on my part as supervisor. My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Regrettable! Deeply regrettable!
However...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All things are impermanent...
Has the time finally come, then?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A proposal! Spar with Rudolf and
claim victory, and the sculpture matter is dismissed!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Could I ask this of you, Air Groove?
I have lacked a willing sparring partner.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah... a fencing match?
If I will suffice, gladly.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Let us begin at once!
Rassemblez! Saluez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then—show me your blade.
Bloom proud and fierce, in full profusion!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even in a mock match—
as the "Empress", defeat is not in my vocabulary.

After a fierce exchange, Air Groove
racked up points and claimed victory!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Not a single opening.
Our academy's "Empress" strikes like sudden thunder.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You are too modest.
Against a serious President, I would stand no chance.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Decisive victory! Magnificent, Air Groove.
Very well! The sculpture matter is dismissed!

After a fierce exchange, Symboli Rudolf
racked up points and claimed victory!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...My power fell short.
A display truly worthy of the "Emperor".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Paper-thin margin.
I found myself getting surprisingly stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though I never expected an easy "Emperor"-like
leisurely victory against you in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Narrow defeat! Yet what a rare, thrilling match!
In light of such skill, the sculpture matter is dismissed!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, a question for you!
What material was that wood carving made from?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be oak?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Correct! Meaning, oak wood.
That horse girl sculpture—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
was crafted to honor a past champion who won the Oaks,
earned the title "Queen", and captured public adoration.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Queen"...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Expectations! Next time, I look forward
to your own triumphs as "Queen"!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: My thanks for your generous leniency.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you will excuse me.

Bowing respectfully, Air Groove briskly
returned to leading festival prep operations—
